features.name: Valmikinagar / Gandak
features.fact: after the Aug 26 Himalayan glacier-collapse flood in Nepal, all 36 gates of the Gandak barrage were opened and 8 Bihar districts — Gopalganj, Saran (Chapra), West Champaran (Bettiah), East Champaran (Motihari), Muzaffarpur, Vaishali, Sitamarhi, Sheohar — were put on alert with NDRF deployed and low-lying areas evacuated. UP and Uttarakhand also evacuated riverside pockets.
features.locate: Approximate study anchor. Valmikinagar Barrage & the Gandak plain — West Champaran, Bihar. On the Gandak (Narayani) where it leaves Nepal and enters India at the Indo-Nepal border in West Champaran district, at the western edge of the north-Bihar plains; Valmiki Tiger Reserve and the Someshwar (Shivalik) hills lie immediately north, the Ganga confluence at Sonepur/Hajipur far downstream.

features.name: Kaziranga
features.fact: on Aug 24 the Central Empowered Committee censured Assam for failing to enforce the Supreme Court's 2019 ban on mining in the catchments of streams rising in Karbi Anglong; the same SC bench ordered a fresh nationwide survey of elephant corridors and barred fireballs/spikes used to divert elephants.
features.locate: Approximate study anchor. Kaziranga National Park & the Karbi Anglong hills — Assam. In the Brahmaputra floodplain of central Assam, spanning Golaghat and Nagaon districts; the Karbi Anglong plateau forms its southern boundary (elephants cross between the two in flood season), Jorhat to the east, the Eastern Himalaya beyond the river to the north. A UNESCO World Heritage Site (1985) and Tiger Reserve (2006), holding the world's largest one-horned rhino population.

features.name: Khalingduar / Udalguri region
features.fact: an Aaranyak project reported this week converts three invasive alien plants — Lantana camara, Chromolaena odorata (Siam weed) and Mikania micrantha — into biochar to restore native elephant forage.
features.locate: Approximate study anchor. Khalingduar Reserve Forest, Udalguri — Assam (Bodoland Territorial Region). Northern Assam in the Bodoland Territorial Region, on the Bhutan border at the foot of the eastern Himalayan duars, in the Dhansiri forest division north of the Brahmaputra.

features.name: Singhbhum Craton region
features.fact: a PNAS paper (reported Aug 24) dated a banded chert at Bhitardari to ~3.5 billion years using zircon U-Pb, making it the oldest directly dated rock carrying a confirmed biosignature of microbial life.
features.locate: Approximate study anchor. Bhitardari & the Singhbhum Craton — Jharkhand / Odisha. The Singhbhum craton is the ancient stable block of the Chota Nagpur–north Odisha shield, roughly between the Subarnarekha and the Baitarani, taking in Jharkhand's Singhbhum copper belt and northern Odisha (Mayurbhanj, Keonjhar).

features.name: Domiasiat / Khasi Hills region
features.fact: on Aug 26 the Meghalaya Assembly unanimously passed a resolution against all uranium mining and processing in the state, asking the Centre to shut the Kylleng-Pyndengsohiong Mawthabah (KPM) project — Domiasiat holds one of India's richest uranium deposits.
features.locate: Approximate study anchor. Domiasiat & the West Khasi Hills — Meghalaya. On the Meghalaya (Shillong) plateau west of Shillong, in West Khasi Hills / South West Khasi Hills districts, on the rain-drenched southern slope facing the Bangladesh plains (Wahkyn and Lostoin lie nearby).

features.name: Paradip Port
features.fact: seven projects were commissioned here on Aug 21 (including deepening to 18.5 m), and on Aug 28 a 30-year concession was awarded to mechanise the CQ-III berth.
features.locate: Approximate study anchor. Paradip Port — Jagatsinghpur district, Odisha. On the Bay of Bengal at the mouth of the Mahanadi delta (near the Jatadhari and Mahanadi estuaries), north of the Devi river mouth and south of Dhamra; a major deep-draught eastern port.

features.name: Rasuwa / Trishuli valley
features.fact: on Aug 26 an ice-rock avalanche off a glacier at ~5,200 m dammed the Lhende; the burst sent a surge that raised the Trishuli 9 m in 30 minutes — 389+ dead in Nepal, 1,500+ missing across Nepal and Tibet, 19 bridges and ~40 km of road gone. The landslide itself registered as a magnitude-5.2 seismic event (not an earthquake trigger, per USGS).
features.locate: Approximate study anchor. Rasuwa district & the Bhote Koshi–Trishuli system — Nepal. Central Nepal directly north of Kathmandu, on the Tibet (China) border; Timure and Syapru Besi sit in the Lhende Khola / Bhote Koshi valley, which becomes the Trishuli, flows through Nuwakot and Dhading, joins the Narayani, and crosses into Bihar as the Gandak. Langtang National Park frames the valley.

features.name: Gyirong border crossing
features.fact: mud and debris from the same Aug 26 flood struck Gyirong Port; 558 missing (260 foreign nationals, many Kailash-Mansarovar pilgrims). Premier Li Qiang visited, and Xi Jinping ordered an "all-out" search.
features.locate: Approximate study anchor. Gyirong (Kyirong) County & Gyirong Port — Shigatse, Tibet, China. On the southern rim of the Tibetan Plateau in Shigatse prefecture, the main China–Nepal land trade gateway west of the older Kodari/Zhangmu crossing, on the road toward Mount Kailash and Lake Mansarovar.

features.name: Tashkent
features.fact: PM Modi's state visit on Aug 29–30, 2026 (his fourth), with delegation-level talks with President Mirziyoyev.
features.locate: Approximate study anchor. Tashkent — Uzbekistan. Capital of Uzbekistan in the Chirchik valley at the western end of the Fergana/Tian Shan foothills, in the Amu Darya–Syr Darya (Turan) basin of doubly-landlocked Central Asia; Kazakhstan lies north, the Kyzylkum desert west.

features.name: Bishkek
features.fact: hosts the 26th SCO Summit, Aug 31–Sep 1, 2026, marking the bloc's 25th anniversary — agenda includes an SCO development bank and the flagship China–Kyrgyzstan–Uzbekistan (CKU) railway.
features.locate: Approximate study anchor. Bishkek — Kyrgyzstan. Capital in the Chuy valley at the northern foot of the Kyrgyz Ala-Too (Tian Shan), near the Kazakh border; Lake Issyk-Kul lies east, the Fergana valley south-west.

features.name: Torugart Pass
features.fact: the flagship connectivity project of the Bishkek SCO summit; note the gauge break at Makmal (1,435 mm Chinese standard → 1,520 mm Russian broad gauge).
features.locate: Approximate study anchor. Torugart Pass & the CKU railway corridor — China–Kyrgyzstan–Uzbekistan. A Tian Shan pass on the China–Kyrgyzstan border; the ~530 km line runs Kashgar → Torugart → Makmal → Jalal-Abad → Andijan, threading the Tian Shan (Naryn, Kosh-Dobo and Fergana tunnels) into the Fergana valley, and feeds the Middle Corridor toward the Caspian and Türkiye.

features.name: Kaub / Rhine
features.fact: Europe's drought-hit summer pushed all four to record lows — Kaub fell to 21 cm on Aug 3–4, the lowest since records began in 1880 — stalling Rhine barge traffic into late August and straining cooling water at the Paks nuclear plant.
features.locate: Approximate study anchor. Kaub on the Rhine — with the Danube at Paks, the Po at Cremona, the Loire at Saumur. Kaub is the Rhine's shallowest reference gauge, in the Rhine gorge between Bingen and Koblenz, Germany; Paks is on the middle Danube in Hungary; Cremona on the Po in the north-Italian plain; Saumur on the Loire, France's longest river.

features.name: Kīlauea
features.fact: Episode 54 of the episodic Halemaʻumaʻu eruption ran through Aug 25, with lava fountains to ~150 m (500 ft) over nine hours before pausing.
features.locate: Approximate study anchor. Kīlauea & Halemaʻumaʻu crater — Hawaiʻi Island, USA. A shield volcano on the southeast flank of Hawaiʻi (Big Island), beside Mauna Loa, on the Hawaiian hotspot in the mid-Pacific — a classic intra-plate / hotspot volcano, not on the Ring of Fire.

features.name: Surat Thani
features.fact: Exercise Maitree 2026 (India–Thailand jungle/counter-insurgency) ran Aug 18–31 at Vibhavadi Rangsit Camp, Surat Thani; Exercise Udara Shakti 2026 (India–Malaysia air) was held at Subang from Aug 13.
features.locate: Approximate study anchor. Surat Thani — Thailand (with Subang, Malaysia). Surat Thani lies on the Gulf of Thailand coast of the Malay Peninsula, near the Isthmus of Kra and opposite Ko Samui; Subang air base sits near Kuala Lumpur on the peninsula's western, Strait of Malacca side.
